cuhkAdmission.introduction: Paving your university journey with our Professional Accountancy Programme The BBA in Professional Accountancy (PACC) Programme was the first accounting degree programme offered in Hong Kong. Our curriculum is designed to nurture dynamic, well-rounded business professionals who will be in demand in the market long into the future. A remarkable component of the PACC Programme is the vast array of experiential learning opportunities we offer. Internships, exchanges, career workshops, study trips and case competitions are thoughtfully designed to deepen students’ knowledge and understanding of the industry. All PACC graduates are eligible to apply for the Qualification Programme (QP) of the Hong Kong Institute of Certified Public Accountants (HKICPA) and other accounting professional examinations. Our graduates are highly sought-after by recruiters from international accounting firms and other businesses. Unleash your potential with our unique feature – A diverse choice of streams The PACC Programme strives to go above and beyond, offering opportunities for students to specialise in accounting or related fields. The curriculum of the PACC Programme offers students the option to specialise in various streams to shape themselves into future business professionals with a global mindset. The streams we offer include Global Accounting, Global Tax and Governance, Finance for Accountants, and Accounting Analytics.
cuhkAdmission.careerProspects: The PACC Programme opens the door to a huge variety of opportunities and leads to rewarding careers. PACC graduates are ideally suited for careers in accounting firms, banks, finance companies, commercial firms and the public sector. If you are interested in this programme, please review the application requirements and deadlines specific to the respective admission scheme to increase your chances of getting accepted. APPLY NOW
